currentParagraphText: “So that means you give up guessing?” Jake said cheekily.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “So that means you give up guessing?” Jake said cheekily.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “... I’ll assume it’s the one about Forbidden Knowledge, as I’m unsure if you would even have been able to share that in the first place. The most obvious truth was about your encounter with the Court of Shadows, as such a thing was only a matter of time, and from what I know of Umbra and the story of the Sin weapon you wield, encountering her personally was also only to be expected,” the Forest King said.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Knowing the ridiculousness someone like you gets up to, all of them may as well be true. Though I can assume the factuality of some. In order to resurrect me, you would have had to kill the Desolate Child of Loss. With that in mind, you must have won the war for the galaxy, having killed Ell’Hakan in the process. Yip of Yore also meeting his death is also only to be expected, though that did happen sooner than I would have anticipated. Starting a war with the Holy Church... hm, must have been in extension of the conflict for the Milky Way. As for the rest of them, most of which seem to concern the personal encounters and relationships you’ve formed, I truthfully do not find myself caring overly much, but I assume one of these to be the lie,” the Forest King surprisingly played along with Jake’s little joke.
